transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you for seeing me. I... well, I hope it's okay that I'm here. I know you're very busy. Um, I guess I'm just having a little trouble with my eating lately. It's probably nothing major, just... sometimes I get a bit carried away and eat more than I should. 

And, um... well, recently, I've been doing something that... I don't know, it kind of scared me a little, which is why I made the appointment. I hope it doesn't sound too awful, but after I overeat, I've been going to the bathroom and... making myself sick. Just to make sure I don't put on weight, you know? At first, I thought it was just a silly mistake, something I'd only do once, but... it's happening a bit more often now. Is that... does that make sense why I'd come in for that?
How often have you been making yourself sick after eating more than you should — and have you noticed this happening regularly, like at least once a week for some time now?

Oh, um... well, I really hope you don't think less of me for this. I know it's not a good habit. But, um, if I'm being completely honest—and I do want to be honest with you—it's been happening a bit more than I'd like to admit. 

For the past several months, I guess... well, most weeks I'll have one of those moments where I just eat too much, usually when I'm alone, and then I... I go and make myself sick. I used to tell myself it was just every now and then, but I can't really call it occasional anymore. It's at least once a week. I'm sorry, I know that sounds terrible. Does that... is that the kind of information you needed to know?
When you make yourself sick after eating, is it mainly because you feel that you have gained weight or because you're worried about your body shape or size?

Oh, goodness... well, I suppose it is a bit of both, if I'm being perfectly honest. I just... I really want to look presentable, you know? I hope that doesn't make me sound horribly vain. It's just that at my age, working in the shop, I feel like people expect a certain standard. 

Sometimes, if I'm getting ready for church and my skirt feels even just a little bit tight, or... or if I happen to catch a glimpse of my side view in one of the mirrors at work... it just completely throws me off. It can honestly ruin my entire day. I start panicking, thinking everyone is looking at me and thinking, "Oh, she's really let herself go." And then I just feel so awful about myself. So... yes, I suppose making myself sick is a way to try and fix that, or prevent it from getting worse. Is it... is it normal to worry that much about how you look? I'm sorry if it sounds silly.
When you make yourself sick, is it primarily to try to control your weight or change your body shape?

Um... well, I suppose I kind of just answered that, didn't I? I hope I wasn't rambling too much before. But yes, I... I think it is mainly about my weight and... and my shape. I just get so anxious about it. I really don't want to be a bother or seem like I'm obsessed with myself, but... yes, that's the main reason I do it. I just want to keep things under control. Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your questions the right way.
